Which shortwave stations broadcast in English?

In the A-26 schedule, 106 stations broadcast in English. The most heavily scheduled include China Radio International, Voice of Korea, BBC, E11 Polish Spy Numbers.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in English?

The most-used frequencies are 17540, 13760, 9730, 5850, 6180 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
